meta.description: Registry for participation laws and left-aspect formal derivations from (E != 0).

definitions.participation_space: The indexed set of loci alpha for which E_alpha is non-null under the declared null rule.
definitions.null_rule: A locus is null if E_alpha = 0 exactly or lies below the declared numerical/formal null tolerance when numerical models are used.
definitions.admissible_discussability: A locus is discussable only if it satisfies E_alpha != 0.
definitions.participation_density: The ratio or measure of non-null addressable loci within the evaluated domain.
definitions.left_aspect_boundary: This validator detects distinction/addressability only and does not test actualized continuation.
